args.summary: checkout-api was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) following the deploy of v2.3.1, with an elevated error rate of 18%. Service was rolled back in all regions to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0. Post-rollback verification confirms checkout-api is healthy in all regions with error rate normalized to 0.2%. Root cause of v2.3.1 health failures remains under investigation; v2.3.1 should not be re-deployed until identified and resolved.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate, confirming the bad deploy.

2. **Rolled back**: Identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production and rolled back all regions to it.

3. **Verified recovery**: Post-rollback, checkout-api is healthy in all regions with the error rate normalized to 0.2%.

4. **Opened incident INC-0001** (SEV2): Documented the failure, the remediation, and a note that v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the root cause of the health check failures is investigated. The on-call engineer has been paged.
